newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ cuts fixed home loan rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ cuts fixed home loan rates.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Friday it would cut interest rates for its fixed rate home loans.

ANZ said fixed rate for owner-occupier and residential investor property loans will reduce for new borrowers to 8.15 percent from 8.25 percent for two-year loans and to 8.25 percent from 8.40 percent for three year loans.
ANZ said rates would be cut to 8.50 percent from 8.75 percent for four year loans and to 8.65 percent from 8.75 percent for five year loans.

ANZ said its fixed loans for business mortgages will reduce for new borrowers to 8.65 percent from 8.75 percent for two year loans, to 8.75 percent from 8.90 percent for three years, to 9.00 percent from 9.25 percent for four year loans and to 9.15 percent from 9.25 percent for five year loans.
It said the new rates would be available from January 28, 1997.
